data.one_liner: Generate secure passwords and validate strength with visual feedback and form widgets.
data.what_it_does: Provides visual password strength checkers, built-in form validation components with minimum strength requirements, and a secure random password generator.
use_when: You need to display live visual feedback on password strength during user registration.
You want a TextFormField with built-in password strength validation.
You need to generate secure random passwords programmatically.
avoid_when: You need full enterprise IAM or authentication backend flows instead of just password validation UI.
strengths: Includes a dictionary of 10,000 common exposed passwords for checking leaks.
Provides both standalone visual widgets and ready-to-use Form field checkers.
Supports custom strength rules and custom enum implementation.
weaknesses: Relies on a static built-in dictionary rather than real-time online breach API lookups.

alternatives.name: formz
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a comprehensive, framework-agnostic validation library for multiple form inputs and states.

alternatives.name: string_validator
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need basic string validation helpers without UI widgets.
